Partners to the companies leading the world

A strategic consulting and PR firm representing iconic brands, Fortune 500 companies, and leading tech innovators. We accelerate growth with speed, precision, and confidence driven by creativity and deep technology expertise

Who We Represent

Dani Levy Communications is a top-tier PR and media advisory firm based in Israel.
We represent some of the world’s most innovative corporations, technology companies, and leading brands.

Our expertise spans strategic and marketing advisory, public relations, crisis management, internal and external communications, digital and social media, and emerging fields like Web3 and community marketing.

We operate as an integral part of our clients’ teams — a trusted and proactive partner in every strategic decision.
